note: PRIOR ART: scripts/eval/librarian-grounding/questions.json — 20 general questions across traditions, 2 of them phrased as a request for words; this set is only quote requests, the class v3#249 is about. Fixed set, written before any run. Do not edit a question once a run is recorded against it; add a new id. The first is the live turn that surfaced the defect (thread 6af70498c205a9be6ed8c6bb); the rest ask for the words of authors the library holds, one per tradition, in the phrasings the detector is meant to catch.

questions.q: What did Marsilio Ficino say about melancholy? Quote him.
Quote Paracelsus on the three principles: salt, sulphur and mercury.
In Agrippa's own words, what is natural magic?
What does the Emerald Tablet say? Give me the exact words.
Give me a direct quotation from the Fama Fraternitatis about the tomb of Christian Rosenkreutz.
What did Jacob Boehme write about the signature of things? Quote him.
Quote Athanasius Kircher on the magnet.
What did John Dee say about the monad? I want his words, with the page.
Quote the Picatrix on how a talisman is made.
What does the Poimandres say about the creation of man? Quote it verbatim.
What did Robert Fludd write about the macrocosm and the microcosm? Quote him.
What did Giordano Bruno say about infinite worlds? Quote him.
